name: Submit and wait for result
description: Submit a URL or file to VMRay and block until the analysis finishes, returning verdict only.

enable_reputation.description: Run Reputation Analysis on the sample and its artifacts (hashes and URLs only are sent to third-party services, never the file itself).
enable_reputation.title: Enable Reputation

enable_whois.description: Query domains seen during analysis against an external WHOIS service.
enable_whois.title: Enable Whois

known_malicious.description: Let Triage pre-filter known malicious samples (reputation + static).
known_malicious.title: Known Malicious

known_benign.description: Let Triage pre-filter known benign samples (reputation + static).
known_benign.title: Known Benign

max_jobs.description: Cap on jobs Jobrules may create for this submission — bounds quota spend.
max_jobs.title: Max Jobs

archive_action.description: How a submitted archive is handled: 'sample', 'compound_sample' or 'separate_samples'.
archive_action.title: Archive Action

archive_password.description: Password of a submitted password-protected archive, if not a common one.
archive_password.title: Archive Password

shareable.description: Share the sample's hash with VirusTotal. Always sent; off unless explicitly enabled.
shareable.title: Shareable

net_scheme_name.description: Network scheme for the analysis VM (e.g. 'Isolated'), sent via user_config.
net_scheme_name.title: Net Scheme Name

sample_url.description: URL to detonate. Mutually exclusive with file_name.
sample_url.title: Sample Url

file_name.description: Name of a file already staged under the action's data_path to submit.
file_name.title: File Name

reanalyze.description: Force a fresh detonation even if a cached result exists.
reanalyze.title: Reanalyze

analysis_caching.description: Allow VMRay to return a cached result instead of a fresh detonation.
analysis_caching.title: Analysis Caching

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for the analysis to finish.
timeout.title: Timeout

pull_time.description: Time (seconds) between polls of the submission status.
pull_time.title: Pull Time

push_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for the initial submit call.
push_timeout.title: Push Timeout
